notes: Video upload and review terminal states are documented. Task status lists WORKING/DONE/WARNING/FAIL without defining WARNING, so no terminal meaning is invented. Visual recording states are nested in per-protocol stream arrays; the device query has no scalar stream identity input and its captured example has an empty stream array. No first-stream waiter is inferred.
